title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 4.16
exact_target: Does almost every plus-or-minus-one polynomial have modulus below one somewhere on the unit circle? If not, determine the correct typical minimum behaviour.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2304016 (AMR-022-4016). CC BY 4.0.
